desc:
The ability to save your custom stages + a ton of new moves and changes have been added.

🤼 Entrance Practice is an interactive wrestling experience where you can fight, roleplay, host, or compete in wrestling shows as any wrestler you choose. Select your entrance from Roblox's biggest titantrons catalog all for free!

🔒 Private Servers unlock admin commands, pyros, cutscenes, and more!

⚠️ Warning: This game contains flashing lights.

💬 Forum: https://www.roblox.com/communities/6959300/WWEU-WWE-Universal-Federation#!/forums/4445c6aa-4f52-452f-8616-576f042c2d57

 All characters, moves, and events are inspired by WWE; we do not claim ownership. Certain moves by Travis.
